optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Service Operations Manager, Cloud Resource Management Product

professionalSummary.text: Service coordinator for the pre-release programme of the cloud resource management console, responsible for staging environment operations, release rehearsals, and incident drills with engineering team.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the staging environment for the resource management console as the service coordinator for the pre-release programme, executing the release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and leading the rehearsal incident drills with the engineering team.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained service runbooks and availability report templates used by the live service team, updating runbooks after each rehearsal with failed steps.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the service runbooks and the availability report template that the live service team used, updating the runbooks after each rehearsal with the steps that had failed.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations (staging environment used synthetic customer accounts) and hand-over items for the live service team in rehearsal reports.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the rehearsal report after each drill, listing the known limitation that staging carried synthetic customer accounts only and the hand-over items for the live service team.

experienceHighlights.text: Executed release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and led rehearsal incident drills with engineering team in staging environment.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the staging environment for the resource management console as the service coordinator for the pre-release programme, executing the release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and leading the rehearsal incident drills with the engineering team.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success during pre-release change windows; production changes and incidents handled by live service team under its own on-call rota.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success in the pre-release change window; production changes and customer-facing incidents were handled by the live service team under its own on-call rota, which I was not part of.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release rehearsal checklist with drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, including staging environment release identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release rehearsal checklist with the drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, with the staging environment's release identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Staging environment operations, release rehearsal coordination, incident drill leadership, runbook maintenance, rehearsal report documentation.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included staging coordination, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance and rehearsal reports for the console's pre-release programme over about two years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with staging environment operations, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance, and rehearsal reports for a pre-release programme. They do not establish experience with production environment operations, customer-facing outages, or live service on-call rota management.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to evidence gaps in production environment experience and incident response for customer-facing outages.
